profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Senior full-stack engineer with 8+ years building React platforms used by millions, from consumer apps to enterprise authentication systems. What I enjoy most is helping the engineers around me grow. Outside of work, you'll find me lifting weights or making pizza.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Leading frontend architecture and development of Travelers' first multi-subsidiary React authentication platform, integrating a headless Okta SDK to deliver branded experiences across the company's subsidiary brands from a single codebase.

Authored the platform's design document evaluating framework and deployment trade-offs, then built a working proof of concept that became the blueprint for the production build.

Serving as frontend lead across a merged cross-functional team, scaffolding the codebase, onboarding engineers across onshore and offshore teams, and partnering with product and design on technical decisions.

Drove structured logging adoption across Node.js microservices and contributed to the migration of services from OpenShift to AWS EKS, replacing legacy Jenkins pipelines with GitHub Actions and Argo CD.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Technical Lead
positions.description:
Led a newly-formed team post-acquisition to build a globally localized parking web app in Next.js, launching in Italy within 4 months.

Spearheaded SSO, passwordless login (Magic Links), and OAuth integrations with Google and Apple, streamlining access for 10M+ users.

Architected parking session extensions in React, Redux, and Node.js, processing 10K+ transactions daily.

Ran the web engineering chapter across teams, establishing shared frontend practices and mentoring developers through weekly one-on-ones.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built ParkMobile's internal React component library with Storybook, driving adoption across every web app and standardizing the frontend design system.

Developed the company's first guest checkout flow, driving a 50%+ increase in web traffic and scaling to 1M+ monthly users.

Built a white-label system on Prismic CMS that powered 50+ rebranded client websites.

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description: Optimized a React-based Google Maps view with 100s of parking pins, preventing unnecessary re-renders and reducing excessive API calls.

positions.title: JavaScript Developer (intern)
positions.description:
Maintained and developed JavaScript plugins on Rails framework.

Contributed to the training of a machine-learning model for facial recognition.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Participated in bench lab work such as PCR, slide preparation, and in-situ hybridization and assisted in performing surgeries on chick embryos. Analyzed and compared FGF gene expression on chick limbs in various time-points.

honors.title: Cum Laude

honors.description: Presented research thesis at the Loyola University Symposium.
